ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, which species increases if all the owls die?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, arrows point from Grass to Cricket, Sheep, and Deer; from Cricket to Rat; from Rat to Owl; at the same time, Rat, Sheep, and Deer also have arrows pointing to Wolf. Reasoning: Food web arrows indicate food/prey to consumer, so Rat → Owl indicates that owls eat rats. If all owls die, the predation suffered by rats decreases, so the number of rats will increase.
